e.summary: 日本法定非寿险费率厘定机构：参考纯率修订公告、地震保险附着率趋势、理赔调查与数据库
e.summary_en: Japan’s statutory non-life ratemaking body: reference loss cost rate revisions, earthquake insurance attachment trends, claims surveys and a data bank
e.summary_hk: 日本法定非壽險費率釐定機構：參考純率修訂公告、地震保險附加率趨勢、理賠調查與數據庫
e.body: 日本损保料率算出机构（General Insurance Rating Organization of Japan, GIROJ，`giroj.or.jp/english/`）是**日本法定的非寿险费率厘定机构**——这是一类在多数市场并不存在的机构：它负责计算并公布**参考纯率（reference loss cost rates）**与法定汽车责任保险等险种的费率，供各家保险公司使用。英文站的三大业务栏目正是它的职能：**Ratemaking（费率厘定）**、**ClaimsSurvey（理赔调查）**、**DataBank（数据库）**，另设 **Disclosure & Publication**、Press 与 Links。可核实的近期公告（2026-08）包括：**Voluntary Automobile Insurance 与 Personal Accident Insurance 的参考纯率修订**，以及 **「按都道府县分类的地震保险附着率（Attachment Ratio）趋势」**更新——后者的地震保险附着率是观察日本巨灾保险渗透的独特指标。对 RIAA：这是理解「**费率标准由谁定、行业如何共用一套纯率**」的极佳对照样本——它与中国的 [[china-insurance-association]]（发布行业**示范条款及费率表**）、以及各市场的商业费率机构形成「**行业统一定价基准**」这一共同现象的不同制度形态；在定价与风险量化侧，参考纯率与日本地震保险的附着率数据可接入 [[catmodeling]] 与 [[cat-bond-pricing]]（日本地震风险是 ILS 市场的重要标的）；市场数据侧与 [[japan-fsa-statistics]]（监管口径）、[[japan-life-insurance-statistics]]（寿险行业协会口径）构成日本市场三源；适合作费率厘定、巨灾保险与监管比较方向。
e.body_en: The General Insurance Rating Organization of Japan (GIROJ, `giroj.or.jp/english/`) is **Japan’s statutory non-life insurance ratemaking body** — an institution that does not exist in most markets: it calculates and publishes **reference loss cost rates** and the rates for lines such as compulsory automobile liability insurance, for member insurers to use. Its three main operations on the English site are exactly that mandate: **Ratemaking**, **ClaimsSurvey** and **DataBank**, alongside **Disclosure & Publication**, press and links. Verifiable recent announcements (August 2026) include **revisions of reference loss cost rates for voluntary automobile insurance and personal accident insurance**, and an update to **"Trends in Attachment Ratio of Earthquake Insurance, Classified by Prefecture"** — the earthquake insurance attachment ratio being a distinctive indicator of catastrophe insurance penetration in Japan. For RIAA: an excellent comparative sample of "**who sets the rate standard and how an industry shares one set of loss cost rates**" — it forms different institutional shapes of the same phenomenon alongside China’s [[china-insurance-association]] (which issues industry **model clauses and rate tables**) and commercial rating bureaux in other markets; on the pricing and risk-quantification side, reference loss cost rates and Japanese earthquake attachment data connect to [[catmodeling]] and [[cat-bond-pricing]] (Japanese earthquake risk is a major ILS subject); on market data it makes Japan a three-source market with [[japan-fsa-statistics]] (regulatory) and [[japan-life-insurance-statistics]] (life industry association); suits ratemaking, catastrophe insurance and regulatory comparison.
e.body_hk: 日本損保料率算出機構（General Insurance Rating Organization of Japan, GIROJ，`giroj.or.jp/english/`）是**日本法定的非壽險費率釐定機構**——這是一類在多數市場並不存在的機構：它負責計算並公布**參考純率（reference loss cost rates）**與法定汽車責任保險等險種的費率，供各家保險公司使用。英文站的三大業務欄目正是它的職能：**Ratemaking（費率釐定）**、**ClaimsSurvey（理賠調查）**、**DataBank（數據庫）**，另設 **Disclosure & Publication**、Press 與 Links。可核實的近期公告（2026-08）包括：**Voluntary Automobile Insurance 與 Personal Accident Insurance 的參考純率修訂**，以及**「按都道府縣分類的地震保險附加率趨勢」**更新。對 RIAA：這是理解「**費率標準由誰定、行業如何共用一套純率**」的極佳對照樣本——它與中國的 [[china-insurance-association]]（發布行業**示範條款及費率表**）形成「**行業統一定價基準**」這一共同現象的不同制度形態；定價與風險量化側可接入 [[catmodeling]] 與 [[cat-bond-pricing]]；市場數據側與 [[japan-fsa-statistics]]（監管口徑）、[[japan-life-insurance-statistics]]（壽險行業協會口徑）構成日本市場三源；適合作費率釐定、巨災保險與監管比較方向。
